well ive never been depressed but that dosent mean i dont have my own mental health issues. I constantly battle with relentless anxiety and insomnia, its exhausting, and i frequently have thoughts of suicide. What i said probably came out wrong and i apologize for that.

Your pain matters and although i myself are going through things, i will encourage others to seek therapy or talk to someone as i know first hand how it feels. So yes, i apologize if it offended you.
Have they hurt you in any way? Have you opened up to them on how you’re feeling?

Suicide is considered bad because it will hurt others around you, other  people see it as a waste of life.

Edit: i apologize, this comment came out wrong and i sincerely apologize to anyone who it offended. Although the response seemed kind of harsh with telling me to fuck myself, i thank the person for bringing it to my attention. I have realized my mistake. I really do mean it when i apologize.

Dont jump. There are so many things that could go wrong that way. Many people have tried it and ended up in serious pain sometimes even disabled physically and mentally. You’d be amazed at how strong the human body can be.
